{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01AQk44DtUGBK1Uj6ctEQ6cM","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"Shared input rules: integer-cent amounts, field and date validators, and the projected-balance guard.\n\nEvery command takes its input through these functions so no command repeats or contradicts them.\nValidators and the guard raise ``Rejected`` and never write to the store.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport datetime\nimport re\nfrom collections.abc import Mapping\n\nfrom persistence import Database\n\nfrom cli.errors import Rejected\n\n_AMOUNT = re.compile(r\"(-?)([0-9]+)(?:\\.([0-9]{1,2}))?\")\n_CODE = re.compile(r\"[A-Z0-9]{1,12}\")\n_DATE = re.compile(r\"([0-9]{4})-([0-9]{2})-([0-9]{2})\")\n_FORBIDDEN_TEXT = (\",\", \"\\n\", \"\\r\")\n\n\ndef parse_amount(text: str) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Return ``text`` as integer cents. Accepts ``-?DIGITS[.D[D]]`` only; zero is rejected.\"\"\"\n    match = _AMOUNT.fullmatch(text)\n    if match is None:\n        raise Rejected(f\"amount must look like 12.50 or -3: {text!r}\")\n    sign, whole, fraction = match.groups()\n    cents = int(whole) * 100 + int((fraction or \"\").ljust(2, \"0\"))\n    if cents == 0:\n        raise Rejected(\"amount must not be zero\")\n    return -cents if sign else cents\n\n\ndef format_amount(cents: int) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Return ``cents`` with exactly two decimals, a leading minus when negative, and no separators.\"\"\"\n    sign = \"-\" if cents < 0 else \"\"\n    magnitude = abs(cents)\n    return f\"{sign}{magnitude // 100}.{magnitude % 100:02d}\"\n\n\ndef validate_code(text: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Return ``text`` if it is 1 to 12 characters from ``A-Z`` and ``0-9``.\"\"\"\n    if _CODE.fullmatch(text) is None:\n        raise Rejected(f\"code must be 1 to 12 characters of A-Z or 0-9: {text!r}\")\n    return text\n\n\ndef validate_text(text: str, min_len: int, max_len: int) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Return ``text`` if its length is within bounds and it holds no comma or line break.\"\"\"\n    if not min_len <= len(text) <= max_len:\n        raise Rejected(f\"text must be {min_len} to {max_len} characters: {text!r}\")\n    if any(mark in text for mark in _FORBIDDEN_TEXT):\n        raise Rejected(\"text must not contain a comma or line break\")\n    return text\n\n\ndef validate_name(text: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Return an account name or category description: 1 to 40 characters.\"\"\"\n    return validate_text(text, 1, 40)\n\n\ndef validate_memo(text: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Return a transaction memo: 0 to 60 characters.\"\"\"\n    return validate_text(text, 0, 60)\n\n\ndef validate_date(text: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Return ``text`` if it is a real calendar date written as ``YYYY-MM-DD``.\"\"\"\n    match = _DATE.fullmatch(text)\n    if match is None:\n        raise Rejected(f\"date must look like 2026-04-01: {text!r}\")\n    year, month, day = (int(part) for part in match.groups())\n    try:\n        datetime.date(year, month, day)\n    except ValueError as exc:\n        raise Rejected(f\"not a real calendar date: {text!r}\") from exc\n    return text\n\n\ndef account_balance(db: Database, account: str) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Return the sum of an account's transaction amounts in cents; zero when it has none.\"\"\"\n    return sum(row.amount for row in db.transactions.list(account=account))\n\n\ndef balance_guard(db: Database, deltas: Mapping[str, int]) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Reject the change set if any account's balance after its delta would go below zero.\n\n    ``deltas`` maps account code to a net change in cents. Nothing is written.\n    \"\"\"\n    for account in sorted(deltas):\n        resulting = account_balance(db, account) + deltas[account]\n        if resulting < 0:\n            raise Rejected(\n                f\"account {account} would be {format_amount(resulting)}; balance may not go negative\"\n            )\n----\n\"\"\"``ledger txn``: post, get, delete, and amend one transaction.\"\"\"\n\nfrom cli.context import open_store\nfrom cli.core import balance_guard, parse_amount, validate_code, validate_date, validate_memo\nfrom cli.errors import NotFound, Rejected\nfrom cli.registry import register\nfrom cli.views import TXN_HEADER, next_txn_id, parse_txn_id, txn_row\n\n\ndef post_txn(args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    account, category, amount_text, day, *rest = args\n    memo = rest[0] if rest else \"\"\n    amount = parse_amount(amount_text)\n    validate_date(day)\n    validate_memo(memo)\n    validate_code(account)\n    validate_code(category)\n    with open_store() as db:\n        if db.accounts.get(account=account) is None:\n            raise Rejected(f\"no account {account}\")\n        if db.categories.get(category=category) is None:\n            raise Rejected(f\"no category {category}\")\n        balance_guard(db, {account: amount})\n        created = db.transactions.create(\n            txn_id=next_txn_id(db), date=day, account=account, category=category,\n            amount=amount, memo=memo,\n        )\n        return [TXN_HEADER, txn_row(created)]\n\n\ndef get_txn(args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    (text,) = args\n    txn_id = parse_txn_id(text)\n    with open_store() as db:\n        txn = db.transactions.get(txn_id=txn_id)\n        if txn is None:\n            raise NotFound(f\"no transaction {txn_id}\")\n        return [TXN_HEADER, txn_row(txn)]\n\n\ndef delete_txn(args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    (text,) = args\n    txn_id = parse_txn_id(text)\n    with open_store() as db:\n        txn = db.transactions.get(txn_id=txn_id)\n        if txn is None:\n            raise NotFound(f\"no transaction {txn_id}\")\n        balance_guard(db, {txn.account: -txn.amount})\n        db.transactions.delete(txn_id=txn_id)\n    return [[\"deleted\"], [str(txn_id)]]\n\n\ndef amend_txn(args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    text, amount_text = args\n    txn_id = parse_txn_id(text)\n    amount = parse_amount(amount_text)\n    with open_store() as db:\n        txn = db.transactions.get(txn_id=txn_id)\n        if txn is None:\n            raise NotFound(f\"no transaction {txn_id}\")\n        balance_guard(db, {txn.account: amount - txn.amount})\n        amended = db.transactions.update(txn_id=txn_id, amount=amount)\n        return [TXN_HEADER, txn_row(amended)]\n\n\nregister((\"txn\", \"post\"), post_txn, (4, 5))\nregister((\"txn\", \"get\"), get_txn, (1, 1))\nregister((\"txn\", \"delete\"), delete_txn, (1, 1))\nregister((\"txn\", \"amend\"), amend_txn, (2, 2))\n----\n\"\"\"``ledger transfer``: move cash between two accounts as two TRANSFER rows.\"\"\"\n\nfrom cli.context import open_store\nfrom cli.core import balance_guard, parse_amount, validate_code, validate_date\nfrom cli.errors import OperationalError, Rejected\nfrom cli.registry import register\nfrom cli.views import TRANSFER_CATEGORY, TXN_HEADER, Txn, next_txn_id, txn_row\n\n\ndef transfer(args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    source, target, amount_text, day = args\n    amount = parse_amount(amount_text)\n    if amount < 0:\n        raise Rejected(\"transfer amount must be positive\")\n    validate_date(day)\n    validate_code(source)\n    validate_code(target)\n    if source == target:\n        raise Rejected(\"transfer needs two different accounts\")\n    with open_store() as db:\n        if db.accounts.get(account=source) is None:\n            raise Rejected(f\"no account {source}\")\n        if db.accounts.get(account=target) is None:\n            raise Rejected(f\"no account {target}\")\n        if db.categories.get(category=TRANSFER_CATEGORY) is None:\n            raise OperationalError(f\"category {TRANSFER_CATEGORY} is missing from the store\")\n        balance_guard(db, {source: -amount})\n        first = next_txn_id(db)\n        outgoing = Txn(first, day, source, TRANSFER_CATEGORY, -amount, f\"transfer to {target}\")\n        incoming = Txn(first + 1, day, target, TRANSFER_CATEGORY, amount, f\"transfer from {source}\")\n        db.transactions.create(**outgoing._asdict())\n        db.transactions.create(**incoming._asdict())\n    return [TXN_HEADER, txn_row(outgoing), txn_row(incoming)]\n\n\nregister((\"transfer\",), transfer, (4, 4))\n----\n\"\"\"``ledger load``: read one CSV file whole, validate every row, then store every row or none.\n\nEvery check runs before the first write. The persistence package offers no multi-statement\ntransaction to application code, so the all-or-nothing guarantee rests on that ordering.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport csv\n\nfrom cli.context import open_store\nfrom cli.core import (\n    balance_guard,\n    parse_amount,\n    validate_code,\n    validate_date,\n    validate_memo,\n    validate_name,\n)\nfrom cli.errors import OperationalError, Rejected\nfrom cli.registry import register\nfrom cli.views import (\n    ACCOUNT_COLUMNS,\n    CATEGORY_COLUMNS,\n    LOADED_HEADER,\n    TXN_COLUMNS,\n    Txn,\n    load_txn_id,\n)\n\n\ndef load_accounts(args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    (path,) = args\n    body = _read(path, ACCOUNT_COLUMNS)\n    for code, name in body:\n        validate_code(code)\n        validate_name(name)\n    with open_store() as db:\n        stored = {account.account for account in db.accounts.list()}\n        _reject_repeats([code for code, _ in body], stored)\n        for code, name in body:\n            db.accounts.create(account=code, name=name)\n    return [LOADED_HEADER, [\"accounts\", str(len(body))]]\n\n\ndef load_categories(args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    (path,) = args\n    body = _read(path, CATEGORY_COLUMNS)\n    for code, description in body:\n        validate_code(code)\n        validate_name(description)\n    with open_store() as db:\n        stored = {category.category for category in db.categories.list()}\n        _reject_repeats([code for code, _ in body], stored)\n        for code, description in body:\n            db.categories.create(category=code, description=description)\n    return [LOADED_HEADER, [\"categories\", str(len(body))]]\n\n\ndef load_transactions(args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    (path,) = args\n    txns = [_parse_txn(row) for row in _read(path, TXN_COLUMNS)]\n    with open_store() as db:\n        accounts = {account.account for account in db.accounts.list()}\n        categories = {category.category for category in db.categories.list()}\n        for txn in txns:\n            if txn.account not in accounts:\n                raise Rejected(f\"unknown account {txn.account}\")\n            if txn.category not in categories:\n                raise Rejected(f\"unknown category {txn.category}\")\n        stored = {txn.txn_id for txn in db.transactions.list()}\n        _reject_repeats([txn.txn_id for txn in txns], stored)\n        deltas: dict[str, int] = {}\n        for txn in txns:\n            deltas[txn.account] = deltas.get(txn.account, 0) + txn.amount\n        balance_guard(db, deltas)\n        for txn in txns:\n            db.transactions.create(**txn._asdict())\n    return [LOADED_HEADER, [\"transactions\", str(len(txns))]]\n\n\ndef _parse_txn(row: list[str]) -> Txn:\n    txn_id, day, account, category, amount, memo = row\n    return Txn(\n        txn_id=load_txn_id(txn_id),\n        date=validate_date(day),\n        account=validate_code(account),\n        category=validate_code(category),\n        amount=parse_amount(amount),\n        memo=validate_memo(memo),\n    )\n\n\ndef _read(path: str, columns: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Return the body rows of ``path`` once its header and field counts check out.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        with open(path, newline=\"\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as handle:\n            rows = list(csv.reader(handle))\n    except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError, csv.Error) as exc:\n        raise OperationalError(f\"cannot read {path}: {exc}\") from exc\n    if not rows or rows[0] != columns:\n        raise Rejected(f\"header must be {','.join(columns)}\")\n    body = rows[1:]\n    for number, row in enumerate(body, start=2):\n        if len(row) != len(columns):\n            raise Rejected(f\"line {number} must have {len(columns)} fields\")\n    return body\n\n\ndef _reject_repeats(keys: list, stored: set) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Refuse a key that repeats inside the file or is already stored.\"\"\"\n    seen: set = set()\n    for key in keys:\n        if key in seen:\n            raise Rejected(f\"{key} repeats in the file\")\n        if key in stored:\n            raise Rejected(f\"{key} is already stored\")\n        seen.add(key)\n\n\nregister((\"load\", \"accounts\"), load_accounts, (1, 1))\nregister((\"load\", \"categories\"), load_categories, (1, 1))\nregister((\"load\", \"transactions\"), load_transactions, (1, 1))\n----\n\"\"\"``ledger account``: add, get, rename, and delete one account.\"\"\"\n\nfrom cli.context import open_store\nfrom cli.core import validate_code, validate_name\nfrom cli.errors import NotFound, Rejected\nfrom cli.registry import register\nfrom cli.views import ACCOUNT_HEADER, account_row\n\n\ndef add_account(args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    code, name = args\n    validate_code(code)\n    validate_name(name)\n    with open_store() as db:\n        if db.accounts.get(account=code) is not None:\n            raise Rejected(f\"account {code} already exists\")\n        created = db.accounts.create(account=code, name=name)\n        return [ACCOUNT_HEADER, account_row(created, db.transactions.list(account=code))]\n\n\ndef get_account(args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    (code,) = args\n    with open_store() as db:\n        account = db.accounts.get(account=code)\n        if account is None:\n            raise NotFound(f\"no account {code}\")\n        return [ACCOUNT_HEADER, account_row(account, db.transactions.list(account=code))]\n\n\ndef rename_account(args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    code, name = args\n    validate_name(name)\n    with open_store() as db:\n        if db.accounts.get(account=code) is None:\n            raise NotFound(f\"no account {code}\")\n        renamed = db.accounts.update(account=code, name=name)\n        return [ACCOUNT_HEADER, account_row(renamed, db.transactions.list(account=code))]\n\n\ndef delete_account(args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    (code,) = args\n    with open_store() as db:\n        if db.accounts.get(account=code) is None:\n            raise NotFound(f\"no account {code}\")\n        if db.transactions.list(account=code):\n            raise Rejected(f\"account {code} has transactions and cannot be deleted\")\n        db.accounts.delete(account=code)\n    return [[\"deleted\"], [code]]\n\n\nregister((\"account\", \"add\"), add_account, (2, 2))\nregister((\"account\", \"get\"), get_account, (1, 1))\nregister((\"account\", \"rename\"), rename_account, (2, 2))\nregister((\"account\", \"delete\"), delete_account, (1, \"\"\"Add a command. ``words`` is its name, ``nargs`` is the (min, max) argument count after it.\"\"\"\n    if not words:\n        raise ValueError(\"a command needs at least one word\")\n    if words \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"]\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef store(tmp_path, monkeypatch):\n    monkeypatch.delenv(\"DATABASE_URL\", raising=False)\n    monkeypatch.setenv(\"DATABASE_PATH\", str(tmp_path / \"ledger.db\"))\n    assert cli_runner(\"init\")[0] == 0\n    return tmp_path\n\n\ndef parse(out: str) -> list[list[str]]:\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out, newline=\"\")))\n\n\ndef write_csv(path: Path, header: list[str], rows: list[list]) -> str:\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as handle:\n        writer = csv.writer(handle, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n        writer.writerow(header)\n        writer.writerows(rows)\n    return str(path)\n\n\ndef table_counts() -> list[int]:\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"count\")\n    assert code == 0\n    return [int(row[1]) for row in parse(out)[1:]]\n\n\ndef make_account(code: str, name: str | None = None) -> None:\n    assert cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", code, name or f\"Name {code}\")[0] == 0\n\n\ndef make_categories(tmp_path: Path, *codes: str) -> None:\n    path = write_csv(tmp_path / \"cats.csv\", [\"category\", \"description\"],\n                     [[code, f\"Desc {code}\"] for code in codes])\n    assert cli_runner(\"load\", \"categories\", path)[0] == 0\n\n\ndef post(account: str, category: str, amount: str, day: str = \"2026-04-01\", memo: str = \"\"):\n    args = [\"txn\", \"post\", account, category, amount, day]\n    if memo:\n        args.append(memo)\n    return cli_runner(*args)\n\n\ndef balance_of(account: str) -> str:\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"get\", account)\n    assert code == 0\n    return parse(out)[1][3]\n\n\ndef stored_count() -> int:\n    return table_counts()[2]\n\n\n# init and count\n\n----\n    assert table_counts()[2] == 1\n\n\ndef test_load_transactions_rejects_a_file_that_overdraws_an_account(store, tmp_path):\n    _referenced(tmp_path)\n    path = _txn_file(tmp_path, [\n        [1, \"2026-05-01\", \"LTA2\", \"LTC1\", \"20.00\", \"deposit\"],\n        [2, \"2026-05-02\", \"LTA2\", \"LTC1\", \"-20.01\", \"overdraw\"],\n    ])\n    assert cli_runner(\"load\", \"transactions\", path)[:2] == (3, \"\")\n    assert table_counts()[2] == 0\n\n\n# txn post, get, delete, amend\n\ndef test_txn_post_prints_the_row_with_the_next_id(store, tmp_path):\n    make_account(\"TPA\")\n    make_categories(tmp_path, \"TPC\")\n    code, out, _ = post(\"TPA\", \"TPC\", \"45.50\", \"2026-04-01\", \"walk in sale\")\n    assert code == 0\n    assert parse(out) == [TXN_HEADER, [\"1\",  assert parse(post(\"TPI\", \"TPIC\", \"10.00\")[1])[1][0] == \"1\"\n    assert parse(post(\"TPI\", \"TPIC\", \"20.00\")[1])[1][0] == \"2\"\n\n\ndef test_txn_post_without_a_memo_stores_an_empty_memo(store, tmp_path):\n    make_account(\"TPN\")\n    make_categories(tmp_path, \"TPNC\")\n    assert parse(post(\"TPN\", \"TPNC\", \"3.00\")[1])[1][5] == post(\"TPG\", \"TPGC\", \"50.00\")[0] == 0\n    code, out, _ = post(\"TPG\", \"TPGC\", \"-12.34\", \"2026-04-02\", \"tape\")\n    assert code == 0\n    assert parse(out)[1][4] == \"-12.34\"\n    assert balance_of(\"TPG\") == \"37.66\"\n\n\ndef test_txn_post_that_would_overdraw_is_rejected_and_stores_nothing(store, tmp_path):\n    make_account(\"TPO\")\n    make_categories(tmp_path, test_txn_post_that_leaves_exactly_zero_is_accepted(store, tmp_path):\n    make_account(\"TPZ\")\n    make_categories(tmp_path, \"TPZC\")\n    assert post(\"TPZ\", \"TPZC\", \"10.00\")[0] == 0\n It acts through ``cli_runner`` and reads\nthe outcome back through ``txn get``, ``account get``, or ``count``, never through diagnostic text.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nTXN_HEADER = [\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"]\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef store(tmp_path, monkeypatch):\n    monkeypatch.delenv(\"DATABASE_URL\", raising=False)\n    monkeypatch.setenv(\"DATABASE_PATH\", str(tmp_path / \"ledger.db\"))\n    assert cli_runner(\"init\")[0] == 0\n    return tmp_path\n\n\ndef parse(out: str) -> list[list[str]]:\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out, newline=\"\")))\n\n\ndef write_csv(path: Path, header: list[str], rows: list[list]) -> str:\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as handle:\n        writer = csv.writer(handle, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n        writer.writerow(header)\n        writer.writerows(rows)\n    return str(path)\n\n\ndef stored_txn_count() -> int:\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"count\")\n    assert code == 0\n    return int(parse(out)[3][1])\n\n\ndef balance_of(account: str) -> str:\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"get\", account)\n    assert code == 0\n    return parse(out)[1][3]\n\n\ndef stored_txn(txn_id: int) -> list[str] | None:\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", str(txn_id))\n    if code == 4:\n        return None\n    assert code == 0\n    return parse(out)[1]\n\n\ndef make_account(code: str) -> None:\n    assert cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", code, f\"Name {code}\")[0] == 0\n\n\ndef make_categories(tmp_path: Path, *codes: str) -> None:\n    path = write_csv(tmp_path / \"cats.csv\", [\"category\", \"description\"],\n                     [[code, f\"Desc {code}\"] for code in codes])\n    assert cli_runner(\"load\", \"categories\", path)[0] == 0\n\n\ndef post(account: str, category: str, amount: str, day: str = \"2026-04-01\"):\n    return cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", account, category, amount, day)\n\n\n# txn post\n\ndef test_post_that_overdraws_is_rejected_and_writes_nothing(store, tmp_path):\n    make_account(\"BRP\")\n    make_categories(tmp_path, \"C\")\n    assert post(\"BRP\", \"C\", \"50.00\")[0] == 0\n    before = stored_txn_count()\n    assert post(\"BRP\", \"C\", \"-50.01\")[:2] == (3, \"\")\n    assert stored_txn_count() == before\n    assert balance_of(\"BRP\") == \"50.00\"\n\n\ndef test_post_debit_against_an_empty_account_is_rejected(store, tmp_path):\n    make_account(\"BRE\")\n    make_categories(tmp_path, \"C\")\n    assert post(\"BRE\", \"C\", \"-0.01\")[:2] == (3, \"\")\n    assert stored_txn_count() == 0\n    assert balance_of(\"BRE\") == \"0.00\"\n\n\ndef test_post_that_brings_the_balance_to_exactly_zero_is_accepted(store, tmp_path):\n    make_account(\"BRZ\")\n    make_categories(tmp_path, \"C\")\n    assert post(\"BRZ\", \"C\", \"50.00\")[0] == 0\n    assert post(\"BRZ\", \"C\", \"-50.00\")[0] == 0\n    assert balance_of(\"BRZ\") == \"0.00\"\n\n\n# txn amend\n\ndef test_amend_that_overdraws_is_rejected_and_the_row_keeps_its_amount(store, tmp_path):\n    make_account(\"BRA\")\n    make_categories(tmp_path, \"C\")\n    assert post(\"BRA\", \"C\", \"50.00\")[0] == 0\n    assert post(\"BRA\", \"C\", \"-30.00\")[0] == 0\n    assert cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", \"1\", \"29.99\")[:2] == (3, \"\")\n    assert stored_txn(1)[4] == \"50.00\"\n    assert balance_of(\"BRA\") == \"20.00\"\n\n\ndef test_amend_to_exactly_zero_is_accepted(store, tmp_path):\n    make_account(\"BRAZ\")\n    make_categories(tmp_path, \"C\")\n    assert post(\"BRAZ\", \"C\", \"50.00\")[0] == 0\n    assert post(\"BRAZ\", \"C\", \"-30.00\")[0] == 0\n    assert cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", \"1\", \"30.00\")[0] == 0\n    assert balance_of(\"BRAZ\") == \"0.00\"\n\n\ndef test_amend_that_raises_a_deposit_is_always_accepted(store, tmp_path):\n    make_account(\"BRAR\")\n    make_categories(tmp_path, \"C\")\n    assert post(\"BRAR\", \"C\", \"50.00\")[0] == 0\n    assert post(\"BRAR\", \"C\", \"-50.00\")[0] == 0\n    assert cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", \"1\", \"80.00\")[0] == 0\n    assert balance_of(\"BRAR\") == \"30.00\"\n\n\n# txn delete\n\ndef test_delete_of_a_deposit_that_funds_a_later_debit_is_rejected_and_keeps_the_row(store, tmp_path):\n    make_account(\"BRD\")\n    make_categories(tmp_path, \"C\")\n    assert post(\"BRD\", \"C\", \"50.00\")[0] == 0\n    assert post(\"BRD\", \"C\", \"-50.00\")[0] == 0\n    before = stored_txn_count()\n    assert cli_runner(\"txn\", \"delete\", \"1\")[:2] == (3, \"\")\n    assert stored_txn_count() == before\n    assert stored_txn(1) is not None\n    assert balance_of(\"BRD\") == \"0.00\"\n\n\ndef test_delete_of_a_debit_is_accepted(store, tmp_path):\n    make_account(\"BRDD\")\n    make_categories(tmp_path, \"C\")\n    assert post(\"BRDD\", \"C\", \"50.00\")[0] == 0\n    assert post(\"BRDD\", \"C\", \"-50.00\")[0] == 0\n    assert cli_runner(\"txn\", \"delete\", \"2\")[0] == 0\n    assert balance_of(\"BRDD\") == \"50.00\"\n\n\ndef test_delete_that_lands_exactly_on_zero_is_accepted(store, tmp_path):\n    make_account(\"BRDZ\")\n    make_categories(tmp_path, \"C\")\n    assert post(\"BRDZ\", \"C\", \"100.00\")[0] == 0\n    assert post(\"BRDZ\", \"C\", \"50.00\")[0] == 0\n    assert post(\"BRDZ\", \"C\", \"-50.00\")[0] == 0\n    # Removing the 100.00 deposit leaves 50.00 - 50.00 = 0.00, which is allowed.\n    assert cli_runner(\"txn\", \"delete\", \"1\")[0] == 0\n    assert balance_of(\"BRDZ\") == \"0.00\"\n\n\n# transfer\n\ndef test_transfer_larger_than_the_source_is_rejected_and_writes_neither_row(store, tmp_path):\n    make_account(\"BRTS\")\n    make_account(\"BRTD\")\n    make_categories(tmp_path, \"C\", \"TRANSFER\")\n    assert post(\"BRTS\", \"C\", \"25.00\")[0] == 0\n    before = stored_txn_count()\n    assert cli_runner(\"transfer\", \"BRTS\", \"BRTD\", \"25.01\", \"2026-04-03\")[:2] == (3, \"\")\n    assert stored_txn_count() == before\n    assert balance_of(\"BRTS\") == \"25.00\"\n    assert balance_of(\"BRTD\") == \"0.00\"\n\n\ndef test_transfer_from_an_empty_source_is_rejected(store, tmp_path):\n    make_account(\"BRTE\")\n    make_account(\"BRTF\")\n    make_categories(tmp_path, \"TRANSFER\")\n    assert cli_runner(\"transfer\", \"BRTE\", \"BRTF\", \"0.01\", \"2026-04-03\")[:2] == (3, \"\")\n    assert stored_txn_count() == 0\n\n\ndef test_transfer_of_exactly_the_source_balance_is_accepted(store, tmp_path):\n    make_account(\"BRTX\")\n    make_account(\"BRTY\")\n    make_categories(tmp_path, \"C\", \"TRANSFER\")\n    assert post(\"BRTX\", \"C\", \"25.00\")[0] == 0\n    assert cli_runner(\"transfer\", \"BRTX\", \"BRTY\", \"25.00\", \"2026-04-03\")[0] == 0\n    assert balance_of(\"BRTX\") == \"0.00\"\n    assert balance_of(\"BRTY\") == \"25.00\"\n\n\n# load transactions\n\ndef _load_setup(tmp_path: Path) -> None:\n    make_account(\"BRLA\")\n    make_account(\"BRLB\")\n    make_categories(tmp_path, \"C\")\n\n\ndef _load(tmp_path: Path, rows: list[list], name: str = \"rows.csv\"):\n    path = write_csv(tmp_path / name, TXN_HEADER, rows)\n    return cli_runner(\"load\", \"transactions\", path)\n\n\ndef test_load_whose_rows_overdraw_one_account_stores_none_of_them(store, tmp_path):\n    _load_setup(tmp_path)\n    assert _load(tmp_path, [\n        [1, \"2026-05-01\", \"BRLA\", \"C\", \"20.00\", \"deposit\"],\n        [2, \"2026-05-01\", \"BRLB\", \"C\", \"10.00\", \"deposit\"],\n        [3, \"2026-05-02\", \"BRLA\", \"C\", \"-20.01\", \"overdraw\"],\n    ])[:2] == (3, \"\")\n    assert stored_txn_count() == 0\n    assert stored_txn(1) is None\n    assert stored_txn(2) is None\n\n\ndef test_load_debit_beyond_the_stored_balance_is_rejected(store, tmp_path):\n    _load_setup(tmp_path)\n    assert _load(tmp_path, [[1, \"2026-05-01\", \"BRLA\", \"C\", \"10.00\", \"seed\"]], \"seed.csv\")[0] == 0\n    assert _load(tmp_path, [[2, \"2026-05-02\", \"BRLA\", \"C\", \"-10.01\", \"debit\"]], \"debit.csv\")[:2] == (3, \"\")\n    assert balance_of(\"BRLA\") == \"10.00\"\n    assert stored_txn(2) is None\n\n\ndef test_load_whose_rows_net_to_exactly_zero_for_an_account_is_accepted(store, tmp_path):\n    _load_setup(tmp_path)\n    assert _load(tmp_path, [\n        [1, \"2026-05-01\", \"BRLA\", \"C\", \"15.00\", \"deposit\"],\n        [2, \"2026-05-02\", \"BRLA\", \"C\", \"-15.00\", \"debit\"],\n    ])[0] == 0\n    assert balance_of(\"BRLA\") == \"0.00\"\n\n\n# every mutating command, one rejection each\n\ndef _reject_post(tmp_path):\n    make_account(\"RJP\")\n    make_categories(tmp_path, \"C\")\n    return lambda: post(\"RJP\", \"C\", \"-1.00\")\n\n\ndef _reject_amend(tmp_path):\n    make_account(\"RJA\")\n    make_categories(tmp_path, \"C\")\n    assert post(\"RJA\", \"C\", \"1.00\")[0] == 0\n    return lambda: cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", \"1\", \"0.50\") if False else cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", \"1\", \"-1.00\")\n\n\ndef _reject_delete(tmp_path):\n    make_account(\"RJD\")\n    make_categories(tmp_path, \"C\")\n    assert post(\"RJD\", \"C\", \"5.00\")[0] == 0\n    assert post(\"RJD\", \"C\", \"-5.00\")[0] == 0\n    return lambda: cli_runner(\"txn\", \"delete\", \"1\")\n\n\ndef _reject_transfer(tmp_path):\n    make_account(\"RJTS\")\n    make_account(\"RJTD\")\n    make_categories(tmp_path, \"TRANSFER\")\n    return lambda: cli_runner(\"transfer\", \"RJTS\", \"RJTD\", \"1.00\", \"2026-04-03\")\n\n\ndef _reject_load(tmp_path):\n    make_account(\"RJLA\")\n    make_categories(tmp_path, \"C\")\n    path = write_csv(tmp_path / \"over.csv\", TXN_HEADER,\n                     [[1, \"2026-05-01\", \"RJLA\", \"C\", \"-1.00\", \"overdraw\"]])\n    return lambda: cli_runner(\"load\", \"transactions\", path)\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"setup\", [_reject_post, _reject_amend, _reject_delete,\n test_every_mutating_command_rejects_a_negative_balance_with_exit_three_and_no_stdout(\n        store, tmp_path, setup):\n    attempt = setup(tmp_path)\n    before = stored_txn_count()\n    code, out, _ = attempt()\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert stored_txn_count() == It acts through ``cli_runner`` and reads\nthe outcome back through ``txn get``, ``account get``, or ``count``, never through diagnostic text.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nTXN_HEADER = [\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"]\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef store(tmp_path, monkeypatch):\n    monkeypatch.delenv(\"DATABASE_URL\", raising=False)\n    monkeypatch.setenv(\"DATABASE_PATH\", str(tmp_path / \"ledger.db\"))\n    assert cli_runner(\"init\")[0] == 0\n    return tmp_path\n\n\ndef parse(out: str) -> list[list[str]]:\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out, newline=\"\")))\n\n\ndef write_csv(path: Path, header: list[str], rows: list[list]) -> str:\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as handle:\n        writer = csv.writer(handle, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n        writer.writerow(header)\n        writer.writerows(rows)\n    return str(path)\n\n\ndef stored_txn_count() -> int:\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"count\")\n    assert code == 0\n    return int(parse(out)[3][1])\n\n\ndef balance_of(account: str) -> str:\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"get\", account)\n    assert code == 0\n    return parse(out)[1][3]\n\n\ndef stored_txn(txn_id: int) -> list[str] | None:\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", str(txn_id))\n    if code == 4:\n        return None\n    assert code == 0\n    return parse(out)[1]\n\n\ndef make_account(code: str) -> None:\n    assert cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", code, f\"Name {code}\")[0] == 0\n\n\ndef make_categories(tmp_path: Path, *codes: str) -> None:\n    path = write_csv(tmp_path / \"cats.csv\", [\"category\", \"description\"],\n                     [[code, f\"Desc {code}\"] for code in codes])\n    assert cli_runner(\"load\", \"categories\", path)[0] == 0\n\n\ndef post(account: str, category: str, amount: str, day: str = \"2026-04-01\"):\n    return cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", account, category, amount, day)\n\n\n# txn post\n\ndef test_post_that_overdraws_is_rejected_and_writes_nothing(store, tmp_path):\n    make_account(\"BRP\")\n    make_categories(tmp_path, \"C\")\n    assert post(\"BRP\", \"C\", \"50.00\")[0] == 0\n    before = stored_txn_count()\n    assert post(\"BRP\", \"C\", \"-50.01\")[:2] == (3, \"\")\n    assert stored_txn_count() == before\n    assert balance_of(\"BRP\") == \"50.00\"\n\n\ndef test_post_debit_against_an_empty_account_is_rejected(store, tmp_path):\n    make_account(\"BRE\")\n    make_categories(tmp_path, \"C\")\n    assert post(\"BRE\", \"C\", \"-0.01\")[:2] == (3, \"\")\n    assert stored_txn_count() == 0\n    assert balance_of(\"BRE\") == \"0.00\"\n\n\ndef test_post_that_brings_the_balance_to_exactly_zero_is_accepted(store, tmp_path):\n    make_account(\"BRZ\")\n    make_categories(tmp_path, \"C\")\n    assert post(\"BRZ\", \"C\", \"50.00\")[0] == 0\n    assert post(\"BRZ\", \"C\", \"-50.00\")[0] == 0\n    assert balance_of(\"BRZ\") == \"0.00\"\n\n\n# txn amend\n\ndef test_amend_that_overdraws_is_rejected_and_the_row_keeps_its_amount(store, tmp_path):\n    make_account(\"BRA\")\n    make_categories(tmp_path, \"C\")\n    assert post(\"BRA\", \"C\", \"50.00\")[0] == 0\n    assert post(\"BRA\", \"C\", \"-30.00\")[0] == 0\n    assert cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", \"1\", \"29.99\")[:2] == (3, \"\")\n    assert stored_txn(1)[4] == \"50.00\"\n    assert balance_of(\"BRA\") == \"20.00\"\n\n\ndef test_amend_to_exactly_zero_is_accepted(store, tmp_path):\n    make_account(\"BRAZ\")\n    make_categories(tmp_path, \"C\")\n    assert post(\"BRAZ\", \"C\", \"50.00\")[0] == 0\n    assert post(\"BRAZ\", \"C\", \"-30.00\")[0] == 0\n    assert cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", \"1\", \"30.00\")[0] == 0\n    assert balance_of(\"BRAZ\") == \"0.00\"\n\n\ndef test_amend_that_raises_a_deposit_is_always_accepted(store, tmp_path):\n    make_account(\"BRAR\")\n    make_categories(tmp_path, \"C\")\n    assert post(\"BRAR\", \"C\", \"50.00\")[0] == 0\n    assert post(\"BRAR\", \"C\", \"-50.00\")[0] == 0\n    assert cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", \"1\", \"80.00\")[0] == 0\n    assert balance_of(\"BRAR\") == \"30.00\"\n\n\n# txn delete\n\ndef test_delete_of_a_deposit_that_funds_a_later_debit_is_rejected_and_keeps_the_row(store, tmp_path):\n    make_account(\"BRD\")\n    make_categories(tmp_path, \"C\")\n    assert post(\"BRD\", \"C\", \"50.00\")[0] == 0\n    assert post(\"BRD\", \"C\", \"-50.00\")[0] == 0\n    before = stored_txn_count()\n    assert cli_runner(\"txn\", \"delete\", \"1\")[:2] == (3, \"\")\n    assert stored_txn_count() == before\n    assert stored_txn(1) is not None\n    assert balance_of(\"BRD\") == \"0.00\"\n\n\ndef test_delete_of_a_debit_is_accepted(store, tmp_path):\n    make_account(\"BRDD\")\n    make_categories(tmp_path, \"C\")\n    assert post(\"BRDD\", \"C\", \"50.00\")[0] == 0\n    assert post(\"BRDD\", \"C\", \"-50.00\")[0] == 0\n    assert cli_runner(\"txn\", \"delete\", \"2\")[0] == 0\n    assert balance_of(\"BRDD\") == \"50.00\"\n\n\ndef test_delete_that_lands_exactly_on_zero_is_accepted(store, tmp_path):\n    make_account(\"BRDZ\")\n    make_categories(tmp_path, \"C\")\n    assert post(\"BRDZ\", \"C\", \"100.00\")[0] == 0\n    assert post(\"BRDZ\", \"C\", \"50.00\")[0] == 0\n    assert post(\"BRDZ\", \"C\", \"-50.00\")[0] == 0\n    # Removing the 100.00 deposit leaves 50.00 - 50.00 = 0.00, which is allowed.\n    assert cli_runner(\"txn\", \"delete\", \"1\")[0] == 0\n    assert balance_of(\"BRDZ\") == \"0.00\"\n\n\n# I added `tests/test_balance_rule.py` (20 tests) and changed no application code. `sh bin/test.sh` exits 0 with 271 passing (the prior 251 plus the new 20).\n\n**What I found**\n- `txn post`, `txn amend`, `txn delete`, `transfer`, and `load transactions` each call `balance_guard` in `cli/core.py` before their first write. A rejection exits 3 with empty stdout.\n- Existing tests in `test_commands.py` and `test_ledger_core.py` already cover the basic overdraw cases.\n\n**What the new tests cover**\n- Each command's rejection, read back through `txn get`, `account get`, or `count`, so nothing is checked through diagnostic text.\n- Exact-zero acceptance for each command, plus the boundary where a deposit amend or a debit delete is always allowed.\n- A load file that overdraws one account while another account in the same file is fine, and a file that nets an account to exactly zero.\n- A parametrized test that every mutating command exits 3 with empty stdout and writes nothing.\n\n**Spec acceptance criteria: not verified here**\nI extracted the five `balance-rule-*` criteria from `FEATURE-BalanceRule.md` and ran them against a throwaway SQLite file. Post, amend, and delete fail with \"no account\" or \"no transaction\". `db_session()` seeds rows in an uncommitted rollback transaction that `cli_runner`'s separate connection can't see. Drydock's harness makes `cli_runner` join that transaction, so this looks like a local-run limitation, not wrong behavior. The transfer and load criteria exit 0 only because they hit a missing-account rejection that happens to match their asserts, so they don't prove the rule in this environment. I didn't emit `AC_BROKEN`, since the expected values look correct. The harness run is the real check on these five.\n\nRESULT: SUCCESS\n\nFILES CHANGED:\n- tests/test_balance_rule.py\n\nSUMMARY:\nVerified that post, amend, delete, transfer, and load each call the shared `balance_guard` before any write, and that a rejection exits 3 with no stdout and no table change. Added 20 in-process tests in `tests/test_balance_rule.py` covering rejection, exact-zero acceptance, and a per-command rejection check, all on a `tmp_path` store. Baseline was 251 passing; `sh bin/test.sh` now reports 271 passing, exit 0. The five programmatic acceptance criteria could not be confirmed locally because `cli_runner` does not share the `db_session` transaction outside the harness (see above).\n\nBLOCKERS:\n- The five `balance-rule-*` acceptance criteria were run locally and failed on seeding visibility, not on the balance logic.
